new_facts: Canonical action-first messages carry no contract-stage schema and only availability differs within paired fixture inputs.
The injected loop dispatches at most three tools and four generations, with SQL-only recovery and answer-or-abstain terminal stage.
The new ToolSession profile enforces the same 30-unit, three-attempt schedule independently of the loop.
Unavailable reads return explicit rejection without invoking SQL; two failed attempts do not exhaust the reserved SQL opportunity.
Original malformed output and complete raw observations remain in logs; no syntax repair, partial-row exposure or callback retry is performed.

limitations: A working injected loop is not an executed model study or evidence for semantic drift.
